notes.title: The Yarzette Bundle Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981907/fdafc4a1d1a76fb71dcd304d19b680350417cb52.png[/img]
We've teamed up with Limited Run Games to give you the Yarzette Bundle - featuring Yars Rising from WayForward and Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore.

Complete the set and get 20% off one or both games! 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49763/Yarzette__Yars_Rising__Arzette_The_Jewel_of_Faramore/

[h3]Yars Rising[/h3]
From the renowned development studio WayForward Technologies, Inc. comes Yars Rising, a 2D action adventure exploration of one of Atari’s richest, and best known classic titles.

In WayForward’s experienced hands, the Yars franchise becomes an expansive mystery solved through 2D platforming action. Take control of the young hacker Emi Kimura, who is hired by a mysterious patron to infiltrate the shadowy QoTech corporation. Run, jump, sneak, and hack your way through challenges as you slowly unravel a complex secret shrouded in intrigue.

[h3]Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore[/h3]
After ten years of peace...the evil Daimur has returned! Princess Arzette is the Kingdom of Faramore’s only hope to restore harmony to the land!

In this brand new interactive action adventure game, you control the resourceful princess Arzette. Travel through multiple breathtaking locations filled with scum, villainy and secrets, speak with the locals to uncover mysteries and objectives, and take on the evil Daimur as Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore brings you the best interactive gaming experience since the invention of the CD-ROM!

notes.title: Official Soundtrack Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Greetings Yar Warriors!

We hope you have been enjoying hacking terminals and destroying cute robots on your mission to help Emi take down QoTech! 

A lot of you have been mentioning how much you love the game’s music in particular…

It took a bit of time to get the files off of QoTech’s servers without them noticing, but we now have the official soundtrack, The Sound of Yars Rising, available to download right on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3226170/The_Sound_of_Yars_Rising__Official_Soundtrack/

Featuring over 2 hours of music across 53 tracks and over 22 different artists, now you can enjoy listening to The Sound of Yars Rising whenever you want!

This soundtrack is also available in a bundle with the full game for 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45058/Yars_Rising__Soundtrack_Bundle/

And if you prefer to have YouTube playing in the background, perhaps while you’re working or studying (or hacking), then check out Yars Rising Radio - Complete Soundtrack MEGAMIX on the WayForward YouTube channel!

[previewyoutube=NehomSzQ1t4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Yars Rising Demo is BACK for a limited time!

Atari is at PAX West! We will have a number of games for attendees to try out, including Yars Rising. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981907/2f254f6a73d7cd66815b8ae3e8cb032ca2a6e554.jpg[/img]

To celebrate, and to bring some of the fun to anyone that isn't able to venture out to Seattle, WA, the Steam demo is BACK!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000210/Yars_Rising_Demo/

But act fast! This demo will only be available for the duration of PAX West so play it while you can, now through September 2nd!

Yars Rising releases September 10th, wishlist to be notified as soon as it's available!
